summary.text: Brandi Vandivier is the Democratic candidate for Indiana House of Representatives District 42 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A neonatal nurse practitioner and former member of the North Central Parke Community School Corporation board, she also ran in the 2020 Democratic primary for the same seat.

paragraphs.text: Brandi Vandivier was born in Terre Haute, Indiana, earned an undergraduate degree from Indiana State University in May 2000, and received a graduate degree from Indiana University in May 2006.
Her professional experience includes working as a neonatal nurse practitioner.
Vandivier served on the North Central Parke Community School Corporation school board, representing District 7.
She ran in the June 2, 2020 Democratic primary for Indiana House District 42, finishing second with 1,681 votes (38.3%) behind Amy Burke Adams.

In a Ballotpedia survey for 2026, Vandivier said her key messages are raising wages and supporting paid family and medical leave and collective bargaining, supporting public schools over private-school tuition subsidies, and addressing healthcare costs and Medicaid cuts.
She listed IBEW Local 725 as an endorser.
